title: Reflection cube map
holds: Six HDR faces; the game refreshes some faces each frame.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Reflection cube depth
holds: Depth and stencil for the cube map faces.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11 (as R32F depth)

title: Second shadow map set
holds: 16-bit depth array at low resolution, drawn before the cascades.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Sun shadow cascades
holds: 16-bit depth, one array layer per cascade, drawn before the scene.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Volumetric lighting volume
holds: 3D float texture written by compute dispatches.
shared: not yet (3D)

title: Volumetric lighting volume
holds: 3D float texture written by compute dispatches.
shared: not yet (3D)

title: Depth and stencil
holds: The scene's depth buffer (24-bit, 0 near, 1 far) and 8-bit stencil.
shared: every frame, as R32F depth

title: Depth after the depth prepass
holds: A copy of the depth buffer taken right after the prepass; later bound as depth for a few late draws.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11 (as R32F depth)

title: Shadow mask
holds: One full-screen draw before the opaque pass. R: 1 lit, 0 in the sun's shadow.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Motion vectors
holds: Opaque pass target 1. Screen-space velocity: (current NDC - previous NDC) * (-0.5, 0.5), from the game's lighting shader.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Normals and masks
holds: Opaque pass target 2. RG: view-space normal, n.xy / sqrt(8 - 8 n.z) + 0.5. A: specular mask the game's reflections read. B: a small per-material value.
shared: every frame

title: Scene colour, HDR
holds: Lit scene in linear light. Opaque pass target 0; blended draws, the game's own AO, fog and bloom land here later.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Two-channel opaque mask
holds: Opaque pass target 3. G marks snow-shaded surfaces in this frame; R stays near zero.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Normals and masks, half size
holds: Downsample of the normal target for the game's reflections.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Screen-space reflections
holds: Half-size HDR targets of the game's reflection passes (trace, then filters).
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Scene colour, packed float

title: Scene colour copy
holds: A copy of the scene colour taken before the blended draws; the source for refraction.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Water colour target
holds: HDR target drawn with the scene depth; holds the visible water surface in this frame.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Water mask target
holds: 10-bit target written together with the scene colour by one draw; alpha marks the water area.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Blended-draw mask
holds: Two-channel target bound with the scene colour for every blended draw.
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Blended-draw colour
holds: HDR target bound with the scene colour for every blended draw (clouds, mist, effects).
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Volumetric lighting, screen
holds: Full-size single-channel float: the volume resolved to the screen (draw, then compute filters).
shared: on demand; D3D12 read equals D3D11

title: Depth after the scene
